instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pick which version of a page, offer, headline or feature one visitor gets, from rules you write as data, keeping the same visitor on the same version", and give it surface ({ entity_type: 'selection-surface', address, decider_program_ref, candidates: [{ candidate_id, material_ref }] }); decider ({ entity_type: 'decider', decider_id, score, accepts_trust: [text] }; score is a structured expression such as { op: 'sticky_hash', ...).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:choose-what-a-visitor-sees and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Scores every candidate version with a decider (a rule written as structured data: a split by visitor, a switch on what is known about the visitor, a preference for the version with the best recorded result) and returns the winner, the full ranking and any findings.
